title: Bounded material/state/process coverage and later worked-record exhibit
edition_boundary: This exhibit was prepared after the 3 October application. It is separate review content, not retroactively adopted into its 99 paragraphs, 199 claims or 47-page PDF, and not an earlier disclosure, filing or public-availability date.
scope: Selected existing examples, all current claim numbers and explicit unsupported regions are accounted for. This finite matrix does not establish every material/state/process combination or all property laws.
inventor_designation: Robert M. Layne remains user-directed proposed sole inventor for review; no new conception or legal inventorship determination is inferred.

composition.description: Strictly positive rational targets have no imposed floor or domain-wide denominator cap. The original module separately retains a 10^-19 floor; D=10^19 is an optional grid. Real irrational coordinates remain symbolic. Normalization correlates coordinate intervals.

structure.description: An overall vector requires independently identified structure; there is no default phase.

state.description: Inventory region, time, species and mass allocation must be supplied for a physical record.

process.description: Numerical indexing, conversion and witness assignment are calculation operations, without a universal preparation route.

property.description: No property follows from an address. Bounds and covariance concern stipulated input knowledge, not a measured specimen.

remaining_physical_support.description: Exact targets do not establish availability, stable phases, making conditions, measured absence, useful outcome or practical resolution.

composition.description: Ideal Cr/Fe/Co/Ni and Cr/Mn/Fe/Co/Ni principal atomic targets are quarters and fifths. Additional carbon changes support and denominator; principal targets are not exhaustive whole-specimen assays.

structure.description: Attributed selected source reports FCC alloys and grain-boundary context; no candidate phase is established.

state.description: Source-local anneal and diffusion conditions apply only to the attributed specimens. A candidate needs matched temperature, history, impurity and observation fields.

process.description: Selected source-local co-melting/remelting and homogenization are attributed. Supplementary Table S1 is an uninspected dependency in the source review.

property.description: Boundary transport comparison remains a conditional source-informed inquiry with separately specified thermal and microstructural state.

remaining_physical_support.description: Feed purity, full retained support, impurity quantities, segregation, volatility, phase coexistence and candidate transport remain unresolved.

composition.description: Principal B/Si/P/Cr/Ni/Nb count target is (32,5,160,87,686,30)/1000. Separate below-grid Al and closed-box records retain exact fractions and their own inventories.

structure.description: Attributed source-local glass diagnostics and preparation geometry remain distinct from complete retained inventory and candidate local order.

state.description: Thermal trajectory, initial nuclei, observation conditions and temperature-dependent nucleation/growth require support. Residence W alone does not order crystallization outcomes.

process.description: Source-local melt/flux/quench operations and their inspection limits are attributed; unsupported route conditions are not supplied.

property.description: Lower crystalline signal is a conditional inquiry, with different paths or nuclei as alternatives; no universal critical cooling rule is asserted.

remaining_physical_support.description: Whole inventory, retained flux, candidate geometry, kinetic weighting and actual candidate phase/property measurements remain unresolved.

composition.description: Nominal TiO2 formula gives canonical (O,Ti) atomic fractions (2/3,1/3); denominator three is absent from D=10^19.

structure.description: The attributed Xiang et al. example is phase B and nanosheet morphology. Formula, phase and exposed surface are separate features.

state.description: Reported source conditions are local to that teaching; actual candidate retained surfaces, dimensions and complete inventory are unknown.
